source.author: cic
source.text: ex quibus quoniam tamquam ex scrupulosis cotibus enavigavit oratio, reliquae disputationis cursum teneamus, modo satis illa dilucide dixerimus pro rerum obscuritate.
source.text_original: ex quibus quoniam tamquam ex scrupulosis cotibus enavigavit oratio, reliquae disputationis cursum teneamus, modo satis illa dilucide dixerimus pro rerum obscuritate.
source.text_english: Since speech has now sailed past these points, as if past jagged rocks, let us keep the course of the rest of the discussion, provided I have spoken with enough clarity for a subject that is itself obscure.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Sed quoniam e scopulosis locis enauigauit oratio et inter cauas spumeis fluctibus cautes fragilis in altum cumba processit, expandenda uela sunt uentis et quaestionum scopulis transuadatis laetantium more nautarum epilogi celeuma cantandum est.
reuse.text_original: Sed quoniam e scopulosis locis enauigauit oratio et inter cauas spumeis fluctibus cautes fragilis in altum cumba processit, expandenda uela sunt uentis et quaestionum scopulis transuadatis laetantium more nautarum epilogi celeuma cantandum est.
reuse.text_english: But since the discourse has sailed out from rocky places and the fragile boat has advanced into the deep between hollow reefs and foaming waves, the sails must be spread to the winds, and, the reefs of the questions having been crossed, a closing song must be sung in the manner of rejoicing sailors.
